38d0ce4c4c26:
Sometimes we are blessed with miracles that come into our lives suddenly, like gifts from the Divine, who smiles on us indulgently as we stand amazed...

Not many miracles have happened in my life; there have been few, but they were overwhelming! The most recent one happened in 2019, on the day of the Annunciation, a holy day on which I began to paint icons on glass.

I didn't know much about the icons painted on glass by our wonderful Transylvanian peasants, about their soul, about their technique, unique in the world, of painting religious scenes in vivid colours, with oversized decorations and in images that blended their real lives with biblical scenes... And I had never painted until that day!

It was the beginning! Since then I have painted about 300 icons, which are now mostly in private collections of public figures and ordinary people (all of them remarkable people), and in a few churches and monasteries in Romania.

I thank the Lord for this miracle in my life and for giving an extraordinary meaning to the rest of my life!

c38cee04c03b:
• 20 July: the Romanian Orthodox Church celebrates the ascent into heaven of the Holy Great Prophet Elijah the Tishbite, a saint honoured as a great wonderworker and bringer of rain in times of drought.

• We welcome the great feast with an icon on glass, made after the icon «The Ascent of the Holy Prophet Elijah into Heaven, with scenes from his life» (Șcheii Brașovului, model from the early 19th century)

• About the icon:

• I painted this icon after a 19th-century Transylvanian model, in the traditional technique. The icon shows the classic scene of Saint Elijah appearing in the chariot of fire. In the upper part, this chariot appears in the sky, drawn by two red winged horses. The saint stands in the chariot, holding the reins in one hand and in the other the whip with which he drives the horses. The chariot is surrounded by flames. In the lower part, on the ground, Saint Elijah is shown fed by the ravens, and Elisha, with his hands joined in prayer, awaiting Saint Elijah's mantle.

• Many happy returns to all who celebrate their name day!🥀

•«The Holy Trinity» in an icon on glass, a study after an icon made by Ioan Pop of Făgăraș in the mid-19th century, known for his unmistakable style, which works within the Byzantine tradition, with Baroque influences and, of course, local folk art.

d8617126911a:
🌿«Saint Irene of Magedon, the Great Martyr» – icon on glass

- Saint Irene is celebrated on 5 May

- Saint Irene of Magedon, the Great Martyr, lived in the 4th century and suffered for her faith in Christ.

- Her name, Irene, means "peace" in Greek.

- She is known for preaching Christianity despite persecution, and for bringing many people to the faith through her sufferings.

- Her story is one of faith, courage and perseverance.

28a863864e2a:
17 April: «The Life-giving Spring»

⊹ A feast on Bright Friday... It is a feast dedicated to the Mother of God, recalling the role of the Virgin Mary in the salvation of mankind.

⊹ A warm feast dedicated to the Mother of God, reminding us of Good Friday, of the tears and pain of the Sorrowful Mother... Then, the Mother of God suffered and wept beside the Saviour's Cross.
Today, the tears of the Mother of God are a Healing Spring of hope and of healing from illness, wounds and suffering.

⊹ The icon we are showing you today is “The Sorrowful Mother of God”, painted in our workshop (model: Savu Moga, Țara Făgărașului, 1877).

- This work is one of the most dramatic in Savu Moga's whole body of work, thanks to the elegance, grace and expressiveness of the Mother of God's face.

- Everything stands out against a background with a reddish patina.

- Groups of cherubim whirl among the figures of the Holy Spirit, God the Father and the crucified Jesus.

- The elongated body of Jesus is fluid and graceful above Golgotha.

- In the left corner there is a Cyrillic inscription, a quatrain, very unusual for master Moga, which says: “... He who by His word alone / made the heavens and the earth / is nailed upon the cross / a thing unheard of / 1877”.
db90576fdc83:
«The Resurrection of the Lord Jesus» is the greatest feast of Christendom.

⊹"I am the resurrection and the life; whoever believes in Me, though he die, yet shall he live. And whoever lives and believes in Me shall never die. Do you believe this?" (Jesus to Martha, in John)

⊹ In honour of the feast, we are showing you today an icon on glass (model: after a 19th-century icon, Savu Moga)

⊹ About the icon:

-The theme, treated in the Western manner, shows Jesus holding the banner of victory, standing on the clouds. The soldiers who guarded His tomb look up at Him. The two Myrrh-bearing Women complete the picture, together with a praying angel.

-The soldiers wear hussar uniforms: red and green tunics with gold braid, blue trousers, red boots and helmets with red crowns, gilded mounts and plumes. The soldier on the left wears a shirt of gilded chain mail and holds a curved sabre above his head. The composition is set within a border. (Description: the National Museum of the Romanian Peasant)

⊹ The icon is not available. If you would like an icon on glass on this theme (or any other iconographic theme), contact me and we will settle the details.

⊹ May the Feast of the Resurrection be blessed with joy in every soul and in every home! Christ is risen!
e56adb473762:
• «The Last Supper» – icon on glass (model: Savu Moga, Arpașu de Sus, Țara Oltului, 1859)

• Holy Thursday is dedicated to the memory of four events in the life of Jesus: the washing of the disciples' feet, the Last Supper, the high-priestly prayer before the Passion, where the emphasis falls on love, and the beginning of the Passion with the betrayal of the Lord Jesus Christ.

• Vasile Ioana (priest): “Jesus's sermon at «the Last Supper» is a sermon showing that love should guide our lives.”
